Title: Sanjay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Sanjay - 30 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 29 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vinod - 38 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Meenakshi stands in the kitchen. Sanjay and Vinod stand near her.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Meenakshi rolls out rotis on the board.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

[Meenakshi stirs the dal in the pot.]

Meenakshi: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

Meenakshi: "Sanjay, look over here."

[Meenakshi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Sanjay stands in the living room. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Sanjay sips red wine.]

Sanjay: "Okay, Meenakshi."

[Sanjay drinks a beer.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Sanjay staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Sanjay (gently): "Meenakshi, look at this."

[Sanjay walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Sanjay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
